body_samples.text: The median steady-state trough concentration ranged from 0.21 mcg/mL to 0.26 mcg/mL (45 mg; n = 242 to 390) and from 0.47 mcg/mL to 0.49 mcg/mL (90 mg; n = 236 to 386) in patients with psoriasis.

In a population pharmacokinetic analysis, the clearance of ustekinumab was 0.19 L/day (95% CI: 0.185, 0.197) in patients with Crohn’s disease and 0.19 L/day (95% CI: 0.179, 0.192) in patients with ulcerative colitis with an estimated median terminal half-life of approximately 19 days in patients with Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis.

In both studies, the primary endpoint was the proportion of patients who achieved a reduction in score of at least 75% from baseline at Week 12 by the PASI (PASI 75). Patients achieving ≥ 90% improvement in PASI from baseline (PASI 90) were considered PASI 90 responders and patients with ≥ 50% improvement in PASI from baseline (PASI 50) were considered PASI 50 responders.
